description: TXN-SUPPORT through the ACE OLE DB provider, on a writable copy of main. An ADODB.Connection BeginTrans three times (return values), an UPDATE (Errors), Connection.Attributes read, CommitTrans, Rollback, a further Rollback and CommitTrans with no level (errors); then Attributes set to adXactCommitRetaining (131072) and adXactAbortRetaining (262144) in turn with BeginTrans, UPDATE, CommitTrans/Rollback and the next BeginTrans return value (does a new level start); the provider properties 'Transaction DDL' and 'Isolation Levels' are read; the connection closes and DAO reads the rows. Asks the nesting return values, whether the retaining attributes start a new level, and the net effect.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
